subject: Post-discovery: book 30m intro + nominate ops owner

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-discovery: book 30m intro + nominate ops owner

Hi Samira (and Tom),

Great to meet you both on the call this morning — thanks for walking through Neptune's ingestion and query priorities. Quick recap and proposed next step: we recommend a 30-minute product intro that covers a short walkthrough of Redwood's serving runtime, KV/prefix caching behavior for streaming, and a brief ops/SLAs overview relevant to your procurement team.

Can you please:
- Pick one of these 30-min windows (PST):
  • Mon Dec 6, 09:00–09:30
  • Tue Dec 7, 13:00–13:30
  • Wed Dec 8, 11:00–11:30
- Nominate a single ops/security point of contact to join for the SLA/security portion (we'll keep that section to ~10 minutes).

Attached: Redwood-30min-brief-agenda.pdf (short agenda). Also linking a draft mutual action plan — feel free to mark up if you'd like different owners.

If those slots are tight, tell me two 30-min windows that work and I'll coordinate on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Soojin — thanks, that agenda looks good.

Tom and I prefer Tue Dec 7 at 13:00 PST. Tom will be the ops/security contact for the brief (he owns our infra procurement). If Ben needs to be on for the SLA bit, great — otherwise it'll primarily be me + Tom.

One ask: could you include a short slide or verbal note on how Redwood handles prefix caching for low-latency fan-out queries? That's one of our top technical checks during vendor evals.

I'll wait for the calendar invite.

Cheers,
Samira
VP Product, Neptune Analytics
